description: AEPONYX develops advanced photonics with high-speed MEMS technology, bringing innovative, scalable products to the market. Utilizing the next generation photonics material -Silicon Nitride, their products offer superior performance over traditional materials, supporting applications like DWDM and Quantum Computing. With a focus on teamwork, trust, and technology, the AEPONYX team has deep expertise in delivering cost-effective, high-volume solutions for future scalability. AEPONYX was acquired by Pasqal, a global leader in neutral-atom quantum computing, on June 3, 2025.

Airborne leads in advanced composites, specializing in the industrialization of fiber-reinforced composites for Space, Aeronautics, and Marine industries. With 25 years of expertise, they deliver high-end composite solutions through advanced manufacturing or by developing industrialization packages. Airborne’s focus is on producing high-quality components at high production rates with radically low conversion costs.

Ardent Process Technologies is a high-growth, advanced membrane solutions company, committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming the industry and energy landscape. Their Optiperm™ platform delivers scalable, cost-effective carbon capture solutions for cement, steel, and petrochemical industries. With 30 years of experience, Ardent excels in transitioning technologies from lab to field, collaborating with leaders like Chevron and Pfizer to achieve commercial-scale results.
tagline: Scalable Membrane Solutions to Accelerate Decarbonization

description: Aspect Biosystems is pioneering bioprinted tissue therapeutics to treat currently incurable diseases. Their full-stack platform integrates proprietary bioprinting technology, therapeutic cells, biomaterials, and computational design to create next-generation cell therapies. These bioprinted tissues aim to replace, repair, or supplement biological functions, potentially transforming the treatment of diseases such as type 1 diabetes and liver diseases. Aspect’s innovative approach ensures biologically functional, immune-protective, and implantable solutions.

Biodel AG is dedicated to improving farm incomes, soil health, and sequestering carbon from the atmosphere. The company offers a cost-effective solution for capturing CO₂ and revitalizing depleted soils through their innovative line of products, made with patented processes and exclusive blends that ensures farming practices are both sustainable and profitable. Pangaea exited Biodel in August 2026.

Boulder Ionics, a developer and manufacturer of high-performance electrolytes for advanced energy storage devices, specialized in ultracapacitors, lithium-ion batteries, and metal-air batteries. Their non-toxic, non-flammable electrolytes were designed to perform across wide temperature ranges. In 2014, Boulder Ionics was acquired by CoorsTek Specialty Chemicals and now operates under the name CoorsTek Fluorochemicals, Inc.
Calysta is a world leader in cellular agriculture, producing sustainable protein through a patented fermentation platform that doesn’t rely on arable land, plants, or animals.

CarbonCure Technologies is on a mission to make concrete a climate solution. Their integrated decarbonization platform offers hardware, software, and services that help concrete producers cut their carbon footprint, lower production costs, and meet the growing demand for sustainable building materials. CarbonCure’s technology integrates seamlessly into existing plants, injecting captured CO₂ into the concrete mix, where it mineralizes permanently, reducing the need for cement and preventing CO₂ from re-entering the atmosphere.

ChEmpower revolutionizes semiconductor manufacturing with their innovative chemically reactive pad technology that transforms the CMP process. Their elegant solution replaces complex abrasive slurries with advanced chemical technology, delivering substantial improvements in performance, cost, and sustainability. ChEmpower significantly reduces defects, water consumption, and waste while improving yields and simplifying processes. As the semiconductor industry advances, ChEmpower’s breakthrough technology positions them as essential partners in maintaining innovation momentum through more efficient and sustainable manufacturing solutions.

Cnano is the world leader in carbon nanotube and conductive pastes, bringing critical technology to the U.S. A key component in lithium-ion batteries, Cnano's carbon nanotubes are essential for advanced energy storage and electric vehicle (EV) technology. With unmatched conductivity—10 to 100 times greater than standard additives—Cnano enables significant gains in battery performance, while maintaining a strong commitment to safety, environmental responsibility, and community engagement.

Correlia Biosystems creates advanced microscale tools for fast and precise biomolecule measurements. Their customizable PIXI​ platform requires just a tiny sample (less than two microliters) and delivers quick results, enabling dynamic monitoring of protein expression. These tools support data-driven biology by offering rapid, efficient measurement of proteins, helping researchers and clinicians access vital proteomic data, while reducing costs and speeding up the development of new therapeutics.

Cyrium Technologies led in the supply of Concentrator Photovoltaic (CPV) cells by reducing risks, lowering costs, and increasing profits for customers. The company specialized in fabless CPV cells, utilizing semiconductor technology to convert sunlight into electricity for terrestrial solar applications. By concentrating sunlight onto a small area of solar cells, Cyrium optimized performance and offered customization services through its Advanced Solar Cell Customization (ASCC) program, empowering the energy industry with high-efficiency solar solutions.

Dioseve is a biotechnology company building an iPS cell-based platform to reliably produce human oocytes and ovarian somatic cells, aiming to address some of the most persistent medical and societal challenges around fertility and pregnancy. By turning advanced stem cell biology into a practical toolset for reproductive medicine, Dioseve is creating new options that lessen the impact on patients and improve success rates.

Envia Systems developed and manufactured components to improve lithium-ion battery performance, focusing on high-energy density solutions for electric vehicle applications. The company pioneered silicon-based negative electrode materials, aiming to produce EV batteries that surpassed current technologies by 2-3 times. Envia's products supported various sectors, including consumer electronics, home and garden equipment, military devices, and satellites.

ESS Inc. is a leading provider of long-duration (6+ hours) energy storage solutions and has a 20+ year lifespan with no capacity loss It is made from abundant, safe materials like iron, salt, and water. This solution offers the lowest levelized cost of storage (LCOS) per kWh. ESS went public on the New York Stock Exchange in 2021.

Green Theme Technologies, Inc. is a pioneering company in sustainable textile and materials technology, committed to developing eco-friendly solutions that deliver high performance while reducing environmental impact. GTT’s proprietary technologies replace harmful PFAS chemicals in textiles, providing footwear and apparel brands with sustainable options that support a greener world. Focused on high-performance, cost-efficient coatings, Green Theme partners with industry leaders to drive sustainable innovation across global supply chains.

Hazel Technologies provides a simple way for growers, shippers, and retailers to extend the shelf life of produce. Their suite of technologies actively targets the primary, natural forces that accelerate produce spoilage, offering innovative, easy-to-use solutions that extend the quality of fruits and vegetables, reduce waste and increase profitability for some of the largest produce growers in the world.

Hinalea Imaging Corp. combines hyperspectral and digital imaging with advanced neural network analytics to provide data-rich images for quality assurance and testing. Their solutions are used in food safety, medical diagnostics, and precision agriculture. Hinalea also developed the world’s first high-resolution, handheld autonomous hyperspectral camera, which won the SPIE Best Camera and Imager Prism Award.

InMat Inc. developed and commercialized environmentally friendly, water-based nanocomposite barrier coatings for industries like tire manufacturing and packaging. Free of solvents and hazardous materials, these coatings were ideal for food packaging and could be applied via roll coating, spray, or dip processes. InMat’s proprietary technology provided air retention and chemical barriers, offering performance advantages across sporting goods, automotive, and protective equipment markets.

Kanvas Biosciences is on a mission to map and illuminate the microbial interactions foundational to the health of humanity. They use advanced imaging tools to provide deep insights into microbial life and develop novel therapeutics. Their full-stack technology platform features a spatial mapping discovery engine that captures detailed interactions and connections between the host and microbiome, uncovering new opportunities for effective therapeutic interventions and enhancing patient treatments.

Kovio, Inc. developed and manufactured electronic devices using a proprietary printed silicon electronics platform. The company produced NFC tags for mobile marketing, authentication, and advertising, as well as electronic article surveillance (EAS) labels for anti-shoplifting applications. Originating from MIT's Media Lab, Kovio combined high-performance silicon inks with low-cost printing technology to create innovative solutions in retail operations, brand authentication, and ticketing. In 2014, Kovio's technology and assets were acquired by Thin Film Electronics ASA.

Membrion provides adaptive water infrastructure that helps industrial facilities future-proof their operations. Breakthrough ceramic desalination technology enables manufacturers to recover clean water and critical minerals from the toughest waste streams, ensuring reliability in the face of regulatory shifts, climate pressures, and evolving production demands. Backed by leading investors and Fortune 500 partners, Membrion is shaping the future of industrial infrastructure, where resilience and sustainability are inseparable.
tagline: ELECTRO-CERAMIC DESALINATION FOR HARSH INDUSTRIAL WASTEWATER

description: Modulim delivers transformative imaging and data solutions that empower clinicians to better assess, manage, and preserve the lower limb. Their pioneering Clarifi® Imaging System uses spatial frequency domain imaging (SFDI) to noninvasively assess tissue and vascular health, identifying patients at risk for complications. By quantifying biomarkers of microvascular tissue oxygenation, the system enables early intervention, potentially saving limbs and lives. Clarifi is affordable and integrates easily into a clinician’s practice.
tagline: an ounce of prevention is priceless

description: Nanox Inc. developed nanostructured, high surface area perovskite-based catalysts for use in environmental emission controls. The principal application was based on the use of the complex, nanograin oxide, as the 3-way catalyst in catalytic converters and diesel oxidation.

Nautilus Data Technologies provides patented, facility-scale, liquid-cooling technology for AI/ML/HPC data centers. Its innovative EcoCore CDU and Infrastructure products deliver energy efficient, sustainable, scalable, cost-effective solutions for new/retrofit data center projects.

NewLeaf Symbiotics is the pioneer of Pink-Pigmented Facultative Methylotrophs (PPFM) technology, using it to address challenges in yield, crop protection, nutrient efficiency, and methane mitigation. Their technology-powered products help farmers enhance productivity and sustainability, allowing them to do more with fewer resources. Integrated with existing crop management programs, NewLeaf's solutions improve the effectiveness of other crop inputs, delivering better results for growers.

Electro-Optic (EO) modulation is needed everywhere for next-generation communication and computing. Building on silicon photonics and other photonic integrated circuit (PIC) platforms, NLM’s modulation solution enables faster, energy-efficient movement of data across endpoints, devices, networks, and the internet.
tagline: MOVING DATA WITH FASTER, ENERGY-EFFICIENT ELECTRO-OPTIC MODULATION

description: pH7 Technologies specializes in SolvoMetallurgy research, a new branch of extractive metallurgy. They innovate, design, and improve processes to develop proprietary methods for cost-effective and sustainable metal extraction from both primary and secondary resources. Their advanced technology focuses on the high-yield, eco-friendly extraction of Platinum Group Metals (PGMs) from spent catalysts and other sources, supporting the transition to green energy and enhancing the circular economy.

Pionetics was a leading innovator in water technology, specializing in smart water treatment products for residential, commercial, and industrial use. Its ion exchange technology effectively removed priority pollutants and softened water without salt, delivering great-tasting, safe drinking water with less wastewater than traditional systems. Pionetics was acquired by Rayne Corporation in 2008.

polySpectra is an advanced materials company that helps innovative engineers 3D print end-use components that they can trust, using the world’s most rugged photopolymer resins. Their modular chemical platform unlocks additive polymers with a broad spectrum of tailored engineering properties. polySpectra has been supported by the Advanced Manufacturing Office, the National Science Foundation and the Molecular Foundry.

Prime Roots is redefining the deli meat counter with clean protein made from mycelium, a nutrient-rich, natural protein source. Their products are free from nitrates and ultra-processing, offering a wholesome alternative without compromising flavor or texture. Mycelium provides a complete protein that grows muscle faster than meat protein and is naturally high in fiber, boosting the nutrition profile.

Redlen Technologies leads in multi-energy, radiation imaging modules using proprietary Cadmium Zinc Telluride (CZT) sensors. Specializing in Photon Counting detector solutions for Computed Tomography (PCCT), Redlen is the sole merchant supplier of PCCT detectors in clinical use. Its modules combine advanced CZT material with sophisticated electronics for global Fortune 500 clients in medical, security, and non-destructive testing markets. In September 2021, Redlen became a wholly owned subsidiary of Canon Inc.

RSI reduced the cost of solar panels with its patented cadmium telluride (CdTe) electroplating process, which was two-thirds less expensive than traditional silicon for the same output. The company’s larger CdTe modules further cut manufacturing and installation costs. RSI provided technology, tools, and expertise to photovoltaic leaders and developed the Rapid Efficient Electroplating on Large-areas (REEL) process. It partnered with regional manufacturers to deliver cost-effective, locally produced photovoltaic modules.

Semprus BioSciences developed a permanent antimicrobial coating technology for medical devices, designed to prevent bacterial colonization on devices of various sizes, shapes, and materials. The company focused on creating the first dual-functional vascular access catheter to combat both bacteria and blood clots, improving patient outcomes. Teleflex acquired Semprus BioSciences in 2012.

Floré offers a groundbreaking approach to gut health with its advanced microbiome testing and customized formulations. By combining over 100 prebiotics, probiotics, and botanical ingredients, Floré creates tailored solutions that address dysbiosis—a condition linked to numerous chronic diseases, affecting over 80% of Americans annually. Floré empowers consumers to make informed choices with precision-crafted formulas that go beyond general solutions.

SWITCH developed innovative materials with organic molecules that changed optical properties on command. Their photochromic-electrochromic technology allowed sunroofs to automatically darken in sunlight, cutting heat and glare. This technology was used in automotive and architectural glass, eyewear, and more, enabling on-demand adjustments with a small electric current.

Tactus developed innovative touch technologies and designed self-healing, anti-scratch, and impact-resistant protective layers for foldable, wearable, and rollable electronics, offering exceptional bend performance. Their TrueWrite Film improved writing experiences with enhanced tactile feedback, while patented shatter protection provided a pen-on-paper feel.

Tidal Vision is a world-leading chitosan biomolecular solutions provider that delivers solutions to humanity's greatest chemistry and pollution challenges in the water treatment, agriculture, and material industries. Tidal Vision is composed of the following commercial divisions: Tidal Clear®, Clear Water Services™, Tidal Grow®, and Tidal-Tec®.

Tivra Corporation developed microelectronics, semiconductors, and LED products. The company’s technology platform offered LED-based electronic materials, focusing on improving cost and performance in LED and nitride power electronics.

TruTag has the world’s only digitization platform that combines secure edible barcodes—TruTags®—with consumer-friendly mobile apps to tag, track, and trace drugs, life-critical consumables, and other products. Using advanced cGMP nano-porous silica manufacturing, this technology supports product authentication across diverse industries, including pharmaceuticals, food, consumer products, and industrial and electronic parts.
tagline: Encode the truth with microscopic unbeatable ‘barcodes’

description: Versogen systems are engineered to make hydrogen affordable and sustainable. Their breakthrough electrolyzer technology uses water and renewable energy to produce green hydrogen at scale—reliably and affordably. Built with patented anion exchange membranes (AEM) and earth-abundant materials, Versogen's solutions are designed to significantly reduce industrial carbon emissions and support a sustainable energy future - leading the global transition to hydrogen with innovative and scalable technologies.

Vestaron is transforming crop protection with advanced peptide-based insecticides from spider and other venomous animal venoms. These new insecticides offer effective pest control while being safe and sustainable for pollinators, beneficials, and local biodiversity. Their first product, SPEAR® LEP, is used on over 650,000 acres and has been approved in the EU to combat tomato leafminer pests. In 2024, the EPA also approved their new insecticide, BASIN®. Vestaron was acquired by Suterra in May 2026.
